title: Treatise of the Three Tines in Motion
summary: Teaches chained thrusts and a moving screen of tines to students who already know the plain trident.

title: Handbook of the Trident Counter
summary: Sets out counter-thrusts and fork locks that answer an opponent's attack as the trident parries it.

title: The Fisher's Fork and the Fighter's Fork
summary: Compares the quick darting stab of the fisher with the pressing stance of the fighter and joins them.

title: Drill-Book of Barb and Haft
summary: Drills the barbs and the haft as separate weapons with qi-driven chops and sweeps for Warrior students.

title: A Course in Trident Binding
summary: A graded course in locking weapons and limbs in the fork and holding them with qi pressure.

title: Reach and Recovery: A Trident Workbook
summary: A workbook of full-reach thrusts and fast recoveries that keep the guard whole between strikes.

title: Canon of the Hooking Barb
summary: Gathers the hooking and pulling uses of the barbed tine against shields and ankles and weapons.

title: The Mid-Reach Trident Method
summary: Teaches fighting with the middle grip so that tines and butt both serve as weapons.
